justification: Both surfaces present low-relief animal figures in profile carved onto a block, rendered as raised outlined bodies with simple contours and little interior detail, which gives a comparable overall impression. However, A shows a strictly ordered, register-like stacking of repeated animals in horizontal rows across a broad face, while B shows one or two large curled, sprawling creatures filling the surface without any banding or repetition, so the specific relationships and arrangement differ substantially.
